verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app deployed via Docker, npm or Helm, so the operator owns the underlying data store. That implies control over where data lives and how long it is kept, but nothing in the pack documents retention policies or conversation/data deletion features. The only explicit deletion evidence covers Agents through the beta Agent Management API, not user chat data. Missing for 10: documented conversation/message deletion, configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, memory/file deletion controls, account data wipe/export, independent corroboration.
